title: Choose the visual world for Alliance AI Partners
question: The roll assigned Banig Weave. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Banig Weave
options.lineage: Filipino banig mats, hand-woven from pandan and buri strips in Samar and Basey
options.thesis: Two teams interlaced become one stronger fabric: the partner's warp, Alliance's weft.
options.viewport: A woven field of navy partner strips crossed by blue and cyan Alliance strips under 'Put AI to work.', the AI check-up as the one strip pulled over the rest.
options.risk: Reads as handicraft or tourism if the weave turns ornamental instead of carrying layout and state.

raised.raise: Every price and figure carries its source and date as a keyed note at the strip's edge.
One strip colour, Alliance Blue, is reserved for the single committing action in any view.
Time zones read as a row of identical live strips for Manila, Sydney, New York and London on real clocks.
Every zone is labelled with its literal name, so wayfinding is reading.
The four-step way of working (Understand, Plan, Build, Run and grow) is taught as numbered strips the visitor steps through.

options.label: Engraved Value
options.lineage: Philippine banknote and passport security printing: intaglio, guilloche, native birds and flowers
options.thesis: Value you can verify: every claim engraved with its proof, like a note held to the light.
options.viewport: A note-proportioned panel: an engraved swallow and sampaguita vignette in a guilloche frame, the headline set like a denomination, the check-up as the note's one bright security thread.
options.risk: My top-ranked idea, but security-print styling is familiar from fintech and banking, and fine line work turns cold and cluttered if it leaves the frames.

options.label: Layered Papercut
options.lineage: Lowicz wycinanki and Bulacan pabalat: folded paper cut and pasted in layers of flat colour
options.thesis: Depth by layering, never by shading: each partner layer pasted over the last.
options.viewport: A symmetrical roundel of swallows, sampaguita and waling-waling orchids cut in layered blues beside the headline, the check-up action as the top paper layer.
options.case: Fuses cleanly with the nature-and-birds imagery and reads warmly to founders abroad; holds audience identification, loses narrowly on product clarity because layers say depth more than partnership.
options.risk: Slides toward decorative folk art and softens the calm expert if the layers stop structuring content.

options.label: Centre-rail Reference Page
options.lineage: wide-margin scholarly editions with a centre rail of keys
options.thesis: The site as an annotated edition, every claim keyed to its source in the margin.
options.viewport: Two dense columns around a rail of keys, sources hanging in a wide margin.
options.case: Fuses with the sourced price claims but reads academic and slow to founders between meetings.
options.kept: Sources are first-class: every price and figure keyed to its proof.
options.risk: Reads like a textbook, not a partner.

options.label: Creator Hardware Bench
options.lineage: desk instruments with keycap grids and one orange action key
options.thesis: Services as keys on an instrument, one key that commits.
options.viewport: A keycap grid of services with one bright check-up key.
options.case: Fuses poorly: keycaps and knobs make the site a gadget, the AI-tool look the brand avoids.
options.kept: One action colour reserved for the single committing action in every view.
options.risk: Reads as a product toy rather than a partner team.

options.label: VU Meter Bridge
options.lineage: a row of studio level meters on a recording desk
options.thesis: The partnership as a row of live meters moving together.
options.viewport: A bridge of identical meters, one per time zone, leaning together.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a studio instrument is a costume for an AI firm.
options.kept: Read the room across a row of identical live instruments showing true values.
options.risk: Instrument cosplay that hides the offer.

options.label: Industrial Quote Grammar
options.lineage: industrial streetwear: quoted labels, zip-tie tags, hazard stripes
options.thesis: Name the obvious in quotes and let the labels do the wayfinding.
options.viewport: Quoted literal labels on white with a hazard stripe under the check-up.
options.case: Fuses poorly: streetwear swagger fights the calm expert and reads as hype.
options.kept: Every zone labelled with its literal name.
options.risk: Fashion posturing, the opposite of a calm expert.

options.label: Hand-drawn Zine
options.lineage: marker-drawn explainer zines with a guiding mascot
options.thesis: Teach AI the way a friend sketches it on a napkin.
options.viewport: A swallow mascot pointing through numbered comic panels.
options.case: Fuses poorly: marker doodles read informal and cheap, the outsourcing look to avoid.
options.kept: Hard ideas taught in numbered steps the visitor steps through.
options.risk: Reads as cheap help, the exact fear the brand must beat.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What AI consultancies ship: a light, clean site with a product hero and service blocks, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Left-aligned headline and the check-up button beside an interface screenshot, a logo row and service blocks below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other AI firms by design.
